name: MedRAX
description: Medical reasoning agent for chest X-rays that combines a multimodal LLM with specialist imaging tools.
whatItDoes: Answers questions about chest radiographs, including classification, segmentation, grounding and report generation. It is a research system for medical AI practitioners, not a clinical product.
howItWorks: A LangGraph agent with a vision LLM backbone decides which specialised models to call, such as report generators, segmenters and classifiers, and reasons over their outputs. A Gradio interface is launched from the main script, and an OpenAI-compatible base URL allows local backends.

requirements.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
requirements.description: Backbone model; OPENAI_BASE_URL can point at a compatible server

requirements.name: GPU
requirements.description: Runs the local imaging tool models
